
---
title: "Main R Analysis Runner"
output: rmarkdown::notebook
---

This notebook renders the R notebooks of the project in sequence.

```{r}
notebooks_to_render <- c(
  "notebooks/q_preprocessing.Rmd",
  "notebooks/stimuli_premanip.Rmd",
  "notebooks/movement_statistics.Rmd",
  "notebooks/q_statistics.Rmd",
  "notebooks/movement_first_impression.Rmd"
)

rendered_outputs <- character(length(notebooks_to_render))

for (i in seq_along(notebooks_to_render)) {
  rendered_outputs[i] <- rmarkdown::render(
    notebooks_to_render[i],
    envir = new.env(parent = globalenv()),
    quiet = TRUE
  )
}

data.frame(
  notebook = notebooks_to_render,
  output = rendered_outputs
)
```
